# CLI reference

Every `reelforge` command and option, generated from the command definition in `packages/cli/src/index.ts`. On Windows run `reelforge.cmd`, on macOS and Linux `./reelforge`, or `pnpm reelforge` from a source checkout. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure (or validation errors), `2` usage error. The [command line guide](../guide/command-line.md) explains environment variables and common workflows.

## Global options

These options go before or after any command.

| Option          | Description                                                      | Default | Required |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `-V, --version` | output the version number                                        |         |          |
| `--verbose`     | more output (info messages, logs)                                |         |          |
| `--json`        | machine-readable JSON output                                     |         |          |
| `--root <dir>`  | project root (default: $REELFORGE_ROOT or the current directory) |         |          |

## Commands

| Command                                       | Description                                                                                     |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`reelforge studio`](#reelforge-studio)       | open the project dashboard: create episodes, upload voice, open the editor, validate and render |
| [`reelforge new`](#reelforge-new)             | create episodes/&lt;id&gt;/episode.yaml from a commented template                               |
| [`reelforge packs`](#reelforge-packs)         | list industry packs and their templates with slots                                              |
| [`reelforge cue`](#reelforge-cue)             | open the editor in Cues mode: mark when each line starts (writes cues.json)                     |
| [`reelforge align`](#reelforge-align)         | mark cues automatically from the voice recording (lines and words; writes cues.json)            |
| [`reelforge edit`](#reelforge-edit)           | open the visual editor: canvas, layers, inspector and timeline (writes episode.yaml)            |
| [`reelforge dev`](#reelforge-dev)             | open the editor in Review mode: checks, safe zones, element outlines                            |
| [`reelforge validate`](#reelforge-validate)   | check schema, cues, timing, layout, safe zones and text overflow                                |
| [`reelforge render`](#reelforge-render)       | render master + share MP4, SRT, contact sheet and publish.md                                    |
| [`reelforge snap`](#reelforge-snap)           | write PNG frames at times (seconds or time expressions) and a contact sheet                     |
| [`reelforge doctor`](#reelforge-doctor)       | check Node, ffmpeg, Chromium and fonts; print install steps                                     |
| [`reelforge theme new`](#reelforge-theme-new) | generate a complete themes/&lt;name&gt;.theme.yaml (WCAG AA contrast) from one accent color     |
| [`reelforge mcp`](#reelforge-mcp)             | run the Model Context Protocol server on stdio (for AI assistants and agents)                   |
| [`reelforge schema`](#reelforge-schema)       | write the episode JSON Schema (editor autocompletion)                                           |

## reelforge studio

open the project dashboard: create episodes, upload voice, open the editor, validate and render

```text
reelforge studio [options]
```

| Option             | Description                                                                                   | Default | Required |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--port <port>`    | port (default 4310 or $REELFORGE_PORT)                                                        |         |          |
| `--host <address>` | bind address (default 127.0.0.1 or $REELFORGE_HOST); other addresses require the bearer token |         |          |
| `--no-open`        | do not open the browser                                                                       |         |          |

## reelforge new

create episodes/&lt;id&gt;/episode.yaml from a commented template

```text
reelforge new [options] <id>
```

| Argument | Description       | Required |
| -------- | ----------------- | -------- |
| `id`     | episode id (slug) | yes      |

| Option               | Description                                                         | Default | Required |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--series <name>`    | series name shown in the header                                     |         |          |
| `--episode <n>`      | episode number                                                      |         |          |
| `--lang <en\|ar>`    | language of the template script (default en)                        |         |          |
| `--pack <id>`        | start from an industry pack template (see `reelforge packs`)        |         |          |
| `--template <id>`    | template of the pack (default: the pack's first template)           |         |          |
| `--slot <key=value>` | template slot value (repeatable); missing slots keep their defaults |         |          |

## reelforge packs

list industry packs and their templates with slots

```text
reelforge packs [options]
```

| Option            | Description                                      | Default | Required |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- | -------- |
| `--lang <en\|ar>` | language of names and slot defaults (default en) |         |          |

## reelforge cue

open the editor in Cues mode: mark when each line starts (writes cues.json)

```text
reelforge cue [options] <id>
```

| Argument | Description        | Required |
| -------- | ------------------ | -------- |
| `id`     | episode id or path | yes      |

| Option            | Description                                             | Default | Required |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--draft`         | write estimated cues instead (preview before recording) |         |          |
| `--port <port>`   | port (default 4317 or $REELFORGE_PORT)                  |         |          |
| `--preset <name>` | override meta.preset                                    |         |          |
| `--no-open`       | do not open the browser                                 |         |          |

## reelforge align

mark cues automatically from the voice recording (lines and words; writes cues.json)

```text
reelforge align [options] [id]
```

| Argument | Description        | Required |
| -------- | ------------------ | -------- |
| `id`     | episode id or path |          |

| Option            | Description                                                              | Default | Required |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- | -------- |
| `--engine <name>` | auto: whisper when installed, else dsp (one of `auto`, `dsp`, `whisper`) |         |          |
| `--model <size>`  | whisper model size (default base) (one of `tiny`, `base`, `small`)       |         |          |
| `--no-vad`        | detect speech by energy only (skip Silero VAD)                           |         |          |
| `--no-words`      | only line cues                                                           |         |          |
| `--force`         | replace cues you marked by hand                                          |         |          |
| `--dry-run`       | print the result without writing cues.json                               |         |          |
| `--setup`         | install the optional speech models (one time, ~180 MB in the user cache) |         |          |
| `--status`        | show which speech models are installed                                   |         |          |

## reelforge validate

check schema, cues, timing, layout, safe zones and text overflow

```text
reelforge validate [options] <id>
```

| Argument | Description        | Required |
| -------- | ------------------ | -------- |
| `id`     | episode id or path | yes      |

| Option            | Description                       | Default | Required |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--strict`        | fail on warnings too              |         |          |
| `--preset <name>` | override meta.preset              |         |          |
| `--no-measure`    | skip the headless V-9/V-10 checks |         |          |

## reelforge render

render master + share MP4, SRT, contact sheet and publish.md

```text
reelforge render [options] [id]
```

| Argument | Description                                             | Required |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `id`     | episode id or path (or a folder of episodes with --all) |          |

| Option              | Description                                                            | Default | Required |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--all`             | render every episode in episodes/ (or in the given folder)             |         |          |
| `--preset <name>`   | tiktok \| reels \| shorts (default: meta.preset, $REELFORGE_PRESET)    |         |          |
| `--workers <n>`     | parallel Chromium workers (default: CPU cores − 1, $REELFORGE_WORKERS) |         |          |
| `--from <t>`        | partial render start (seconds) → &lt;id&gt;.part.mp4                   |         |          |
| `--to <t>`          | partial render end (seconds)                                           |         |          |
| `--share-size <MB>` | share file size cap (default 28, $REELFORGE_SHARE_SIZE)                |         |          |
| `--no-sfx`          | render without sound effects                                           |         |          |
| `--no-share`        | skip the share file                                                    |         |          |
| `--lossless`        | capture PNG frames instead of JPEG                                     |         |          |
| `--fast`            | faster master/share encoding (preset medium)                           |         |          |
| `--silent`          | allow rendering without a voice recording                              |         |          |
| `--keep-tmp`        | keep out/.tmp/&lt;run-id&gt;/ on failure                               |         |          |
| `--no-measure`      | skip the headless V-9/V-10 checks                                      |         |          |
| `--denoise`         | remove background noise from the voice (default: audio.denoise)        |         |          |
| `--no-denoise`      | keep the voice as recorded, even when audio.denoise is true            |         |          |

## reelforge snap

write PNG frames at times (seconds or time expressions) and a contact sheet

```text
reelforge snap [options] <id> [times...]
```

| Argument   | Description                                     | Required |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `id`       | episode id or path                              | yes      |
| `times...` | times: 12.5, 12.5s, l7, "l7:'word'", l7.end+0.2 |          |

| Option              | Description                                                      | Default | Required |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--every <seconds>` | one frame every N seconds                                        |         |          |
| `--out <dir>`       | output folder (default out/snaps)                                |         |          |
| `--preset <name>`   | override meta.preset                                             |         |          |
| `--cover`           | write a single 1080×1920 cover image to out/&lt;id&gt;.cover.png |         |          |

## reelforge theme new

generate a complete themes/&lt;name&gt;.theme.yaml (WCAG AA contrast) from one accent color

```text
reelforge theme new [options] <name>
```

| Argument | Description       | Required |
| -------- | ----------------- | -------- |
| `name`   | theme name (slug) | yes      |

| Option            | Description                                                                                                                                                                  | Default | Required |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `--accent <hex>`  | accent color, e.g. #b8ff3c (adjusted only if it would be hard to read)                                                                                                       |         | yes      |
| `--mode <mode>`   | light or dark background (default dark)                                                                                                                                      |         |          |
| `--font <family>` | bundled font for its slot (display, mono or arabic): Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, Cairo, Inter, Manrope, Playfair Display, Noto Kufi Arabic, Noto Naskh Arabic, Readex Pro |         |          |
| `--out <file>`    | output file                                                                                                                                                                  |         |          |
